subject.title: feat(gateway): system change history RPC and Ask OpenClaw recent-changes panel

question: Should OpenClaw expose the new persistent system-change journal as the public `operator.admin` gateway API and Custodian history surface after the ordering and pagination fixes?
rationale: This is a new core protocol/UI capability rather than a repair to an established public contract, and the PR carries the repository's protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded admin history API
options.body: Keep the additive RPC and Custodian panel, contingent on fixing the two correctness defects and adding real end-to-end proof.

options.title: Keep the journal internal for now
options.body: Defer the public RPC/UI until maintainers settle the long-term audit-history API and retention presentation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded admin history API
recommendation.body: Keep the additive RPC and Custodian panel, contingent on fixing the two correctness defects and adding real end-to-end proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged journal foundation and authored the proposed reader/API layer.
